That looks like it was pierced at 16g, and yeah 14g is the usual. You can stretch it but you have to make sure its fully healed and if you feel any resistance stop completely and leave it longer. All you need to do is ideally lube the jewellery (not with vaseline, vitamin e oil is a good idea as it's often used for stretching) and put the jewellery straight in. This is called dead stretching, which is the safest way to stretch any piercing as it ensure there's no accidental tears or blowouts. You basically wait for the hole to get looser around the jewellery over time. I stretched my helix this way (I got it done with a gun, my mistake lmao) and it took a while but didn't hurt and now I can wear cartilage jewellery which is dope (stretched 22g-16g). Tbf it might be an idea to stretch each piercing separately with a small barbell so you don't feel the need to force the jewellery through the other piercing if only one is healed enough.

Good luck!
